title: AceReason-Nemotron 1.1: Advancing Math and Code Reasoning through SFT and RL Synergy
authors_zh: Zihan Liu、Zhuolin Yang、Yang Chen、Chankyu Lee、Mohammad Shoeybi、Bryan Catanzaro、Wei Ping
paper_type_zh: 前沿推理模型报告、数据发布与训练配方披露
best_for_zh: 需要审计数学/代码 SFT、RLVR 反馈合同、分阶段课程与发布边界的研究者
one_line: AceReason-Nemotron 1.1 releases a four-field, DeepSeek-R1-generated math/code SFT corpus and model weights while reporting staged, rule-verified on-policy GRPO; the consumed SFT subset, complete code-RL tasks/tests, and example-to-checkpoint lineage remain unavailable.
AceReason-Nemotron 1.1 发布四字段、由 DeepSeek-R1 生成的数学/代码 SFT 语料与模型权重，并报告分阶段、规则验证的严格 on-policy GRPO；但实际使用的 SFT 子集、完整代码 RL 任务/测试和样本到检查点谱系仍不可得。
why: For the frontier-report disclosure ledger, it lets readers compare a concrete public SFT object and several RL/verifier ablations with the missing artifacts that still block full reproduction and verifier audit.
inclusion_reason: An NVIDIA reasoning-model report with released weights, an inspectable DeepSeek-R1-generated SFT corpus, a related math RL dataset, and unusually concrete SFT/RL/verifier ablations, while leaving the exact SFT subset, code-RL data/tests, and complete source-to-checkpoint ledger unresolved.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary source is the NVIDIA-authored arXiv v1 report submitted on 16 June 2025. It asks two linked post-training questions: how scaling unique prompts versus responses per prompt changes a 7B SFT initializer, and whether a stronger SFT initializer remains better after a long, verifier-based RL curriculum. For this Atlas, the important object is not the leaderboard row but the disclosed chain from prompt sources to teacher outputs, rule rewards, stage selection, and released artifacts.

Three related objects must remain separate. The public AceReason-1.1-SFT train split stores category, source, input, and output; all outputs are stated to come from DeepSeek-R1. The unreleased RL object is described as a question and ground-truth answer, 8 or 16 on-policy responses, rule-derived scores, and token-level advantages. The final model is evaluated on math and code benchmarks under explicit sampling budgets, but those scores do not prove that the SFT release equals the consumed blend or that the verifier is reliable.

This paper belongs in frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger because it exposes more of the data and feedback pipeline than a weight-only model announcement while still leaving material gaps: the paper's v7 blend has 2.2M samples from a 383K-prompt pool, whereas the public SFT artifact has 3,970,332 rows and source counts totaling 514,807 questions. A related 49,585-row AceReason-Math artifact exists, but a complete code-RL corpus, tests, reward code, and immutable stage-to-checkpoint manifest do not. The Card therefore treats the work as a partial disclosure ledger, not as a fully replayable construction recipe. (Paper §§3.1–3.2; official SFT and AceReason-Math cards.)

主要来源是 NVIDIA 作者团队于 2025 年 6 月 16 日提交的 arXiv v1 报告。论文提出两个相互关联的后训练问题：增加唯一 prompt 与增加每个 prompt 的 response，分别如何影响 7B SFT 初始化模型；更强的 SFT 初始化经过较长的、基于 verifier 的 RL 课程后，是否仍保持优势。对本 Atlas 而言，关键对象不是榜单条目，而是从 prompt 来源、教师输出、规则 reward、阶段筛选到发布 artifact 的披露链。

必须区分三个相关对象。公开的 AceReason-1.1-SFT 训练 split 保存 category、source、input 和 output，其中所有 output 均声明来自 DeepSeek-R1。未发布的 RL 对象被描述为 question、ground-truth answer、8 或 16 个 on-policy response、规则生成的 score 与 token-level advantage。最终模型在明确采样预算下接受数学和代码 benchmark 评测，但这些分数不能证明 SFT 发布物等同于实际使用的混合，也不能证明 verifier 可靠。

该论文属于 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger，因为它比仅发布权重的模型公告披露了更多数据与反馈管线，同时仍有关键缺口：论文 v7 混合有 220 万个样本，来自 38.3 万个 prompt；公开 SFT artifact 则有 3,970,332 行，来源统计合计 514,807 个 question。官方还发布了相关的 49,585 行 AceReason-Math artifact，但完整代码 RL 语料、测试、reward 代码与不可变的阶段到检查点 manifest 均不存在。因此，本 Card 将其视为部分披露账本，而非可完全回放的构造配方。（论文 §3.1–3.2；官方 SFT 与 AceReason-Math 数据卡。）

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AceReason-Nemotron 1.1 combines a DeepSeek-R1-generated math/code SFT initializer with a staged, strictly on-policy GRPO curriculum, then studies which data-scale, sampling-temperature, response-budget, and difficulty-selection choices change the resulting policy. The direction signal is the joint treatment of SFT data design and RL dynamics rather than either stage in isolation.

The public SFT row is a four-field demonstration object: domain category, upstream source label, task input, and one teacher output containing reasoning text and a final response. It carries no per-row correctness label, verifier output, reward, rejection reason, or blend version. The RL object is a group of 8 or 16 current-policy rollouts for one question-answer pair. A rule score for each response is standardized within the group and used as a token-level advantage; no KL term is used. The final-answer verifier can observe parsed math correctness or compile-and-test code behavior, but it cannot establish whether the unobserved intermediate reasoning process is valid.

The curriculum moves through math-only 8K, 16K, and 24K stages, code-only 24K and 32K stages, and a final math-only 32K stage. Later stages remove tasks solved by every rollout, so task selection itself is part of the feedback loop. This extends the stage-wise RL recipe from AceReason-Nemotron 1.0 to a stronger SFT initializer and adds controlled studies of prompt/response scaling, temperature-adjusted entropy, Stage-1 warm-up, and overlong filtering. Stage-wise GRPO, distillation from a frontier reasoner, programmatic outcome reward, and difficulty filtering are prior components; the paper's concrete contribution is their integrated comparison and disclosure, not the invention of each component. (Paper §§2–4.5.)

AceReason-Nemotron 1.1 将由 DeepSeek-R1 生成的数学/代码 SFT 初始化模型与分阶段、严格 on-policy 的 GRPO 课程结合，并研究数据规模、采样 temperature、response budget 和难度筛选如何改变所得 policy。其方向信号是联合分析 SFT 数据设计与 RL 动态，而不是孤立研究其中一个阶段。

公开 SFT 行是四字段 demonstration 对象：领域 category、上游 source 标签、任务 input，以及包含推理文本和最终 response 的单个教师 output。它不含逐行正确性标签、verifier output、reward、拒绝原因或混合版本。RL 对象则是同一 question-answer pair 的 8 或 16 个当前 policy rollout。每个 response 的规则 score 在组内标准化后成为 token-level advantage，并且训练不使用 KL 项。最终答案 verifier 可以观察解析后的数学正确性或编译加测试的代码行为，却不能证明隐藏的推理过程有效。

课程依次经过数学 8K、16K、24K 阶段，代码 24K、32K 阶段，以及最终数学 32K 阶段。后期会删除所有 rollout 都能解出的任务，因此任务筛选本身也是反馈环的一部分。论文把 AceReason-Nemotron 1.0 的分阶段 RL 配方应用到更强的 SFT 初始化，并新增 prompt/response 扩展、temperature-adjusted entropy、Stage-1 warm-up 和 overlong filtering 的受控研究。分阶段 GRPO、从前沿推理器蒸馏、程序化结果 reward 和难度过滤均来自既有组件；论文的具体贡献是对它们进行整合比较并披露，而不是发明每个组件。（论文 §2–4.5。）

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and SFT construction: the paper starts from Qwen2.5-Math-7B and changes rope_theta from 10,000 to 1,000,000 for reported 128K context support. It collects math prompts from AceMath, NuminaMath, and OpenMathReasoning and code prompts from TACO, APPS, OpenCoder-Stage2, and OpenCodeReasoning. Prompts are deduplicated; samples with 9-gram overlap to benchmark test items are removed; shorter DeepSeek-R1 responses are treated as a proxy for easier tasks and randomly downsampled. The resulting experimental pool has 247K math and 136K code prompts. DeepSeek-R1 generates the SFT outputs, and seven blends scale from 36K samples in v1 to 2.2M in v7. (Paper §3.1, Figs. 3–5.)

The checked release is not serialized as those seven blends. AceReason-1.1-SFT exposes one train split with category, source, input, and output, totaling 2,668,741 math plus 1,301,591 code rows. Its source labels and question counts do not match the paper's final pool one-to-one, and no release field records the v1-v7 membership, correctness check, rejection, or model checkpoint. A reproducer must therefore pin the public release revision and separately obtain the final consumed blend manifest, which is currently unknown.

RL pipeline: each global batch contains 128 prompts. The current policy samples (G=8\) or (16) responses per question, a rule verifier scores them against the ground-truth answer, and group-standardized scores become token-level advantages. veRL executes one policy-gradient update per batch using a token-level GRPO loss; the KL term is removed. Math verification is answer-level. Code verification compiles generated programs and executes predefined tests. Exact parsers, tests, environments, timeouts, reward code, optimizer settings, and stage temperatures are not disclosed. (Paper §3.2.1–3.2.2.)

Curriculum and selection: math-only RL runs at 8K, 16K, and 24K response limits, increasingly favoring difficult tasks and retaining about 2,500 hard questions at the 24K stage. Code RL then runs at 24K and 32K; from Code Stage-II's second epoch onward, tasks for which every previous-checkpoint rollout passes all tests are removed. A final math-only 32K stage likewise retains tasks not solved by every rollout. When an output is truncated, "overlong filtering" masks the entire sample without reward; the alternative assigns a negative reward. The paper finds this choice stage-dependent rather than universally beneficial.

Outputs and use: SFT consumes teacher demonstrations; RLVR consumes question-answer records and transient rollout groups with programmatic outcome reward; the final artifact is AceReason-Nemotron-1.1-7B. Reproduction requires the exact SFT subset, stage prompt manifests, 8-versus-16 allocation, temperatures, answer parser, code tests and runtime, overlong policy, optimizer/hardware/seeds, and checkpoint sequence. The official model page provides weights, inference prompts, and an evaluation-toolkit pointer, not the missing training implementation.

输入与 SFT 构造：论文从 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 出发，将 rope_theta 从 10,000 改为 1,000,000，以支持其报告的 128K context。数学 prompt 来自 AceMath、NuminaMath 和 OpenMathReasoning，代码 prompt 来自 TACO、APPS、OpenCoder-Stage2 和 OpenCodeReasoning。流程先对 prompt 去重，移除与 benchmark 测试条目存在 9-gram 重叠的样本，再把较短的 DeepSeek-R1 response 视为较简单任务的代理并随机下采样。所得实验池包含 24.7 万个数学 prompt 与 13.6 万个代码 prompt。DeepSeek-R1 生成 SFT output，七种混合从 v1 的 3.6 万样本扩展到 v7 的 220 万样本。（论文 §3.1，图 3–5。）

已核查发布物并未按这七种混合序列化。AceReason-1.1-SFT 只公开一个训练 split，字段为 category、source、input 和 output，共有 2,668,741 行数学数据和 1,301,591 行代码数据。其 source 标签与 question 计数不能和论文最终 prompt 池一一对应，发布字段也不记录 v1-v7 归属、正确性检查、拒绝或模型 checkpoint。复现者因此必须固定公开发布 revision，并另行获得当前 unknown 的最终实际使用混合 manifest。

RL 流程：每个全局 batch 有 128 个 prompt；当前 policy 为每题采样 (G=8\) 或 (16) 个 response；规则 verifier 按 ground-truth answer 打分；组内标准化 score 形成 token-level advantage。veRL 在每个 batch 后执行一次 policy-gradient update，采用 token-level GRPO loss，并移除 KL 项。数学验证位于答案级；代码验证会编译生成程序并运行预定义测试。精确 parser、测试、环境、timeout、reward 代码、optimizer 设置与分阶段 temperature 均未披露。（论文 §3.2.1–3.2.2。）

课程与筛选：数学 RL 的 response limit 依次为 8K、16K 和 24K，逐步偏向更难任务，并在 24K 阶段保留约 2,500 道难题。随后代码 RL 使用 24K 与 32K；从 Code Stage-II 的第二个 epoch 起，会删除前一 checkpoint 下所有 rollout 都通过全部测试的任务。最终数学 32K 阶段同样保留并非所有 rollout 都能解出的任务。当 output 被截断时，"overlong filtering" 会屏蔽整个样本且不分配 reward；另一种做法则分配负 reward。论文显示，该选择依赖阶段，并非始终有利。

输出与用途：SFT 消费教师 demonstration；RLVR 消费 question-answer 记录与带程序化结果 reward 的临时 rollout 组；最终 artifact 是 AceReason-Nemotron-1.1-7B。复现需要精确 SFT 子集、各阶段 prompt manifest、8 与 16 的分配、temperature、答案 parser、代码测试与 runtime、overlong 策略、optimizer/硬件/随机种子和 checkpoint 序列。官方模型页提供权重、推理 prompt 与 evaluation toolkit 指针，而不是缺失的训练实现。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The release evidence is concrete but narrower than the training claim. The official AceReason-1.1-SFT page reports 3,970,332 rows: 2,668,741 math and 1,301,591 code samples. Its viewer exposes only a train split with four string fields (category, source, input, output), and the card states that all outputs were generated by DeepSeek-R1 and that the dataset is CC BY 4.0. AceReason-Math separately exposes 49,585 problem/answer rows, also in one train split under CC BY 4.0. Neither artifact includes rollout groups, reward logs, stage membership, or the code-RL tests.

The SFT scaling experiment reports v1 as 18K math plus 18K code samples and v7 as 1.2M math plus 1.0M code samples. From v3 to v4, adding 16K math samples while expanding unique prompts is associated with +4 percentage points on AIME24 and +2 on AIME25. With a similar prompt set but more responses per prompt, v7 raises AIME25 from 41.3 to 49.3 over v6. Models continue improving through approximately epochs 5–6. These are seven-blend experiments under the authors' setup; they do not isolate teacher quality, guarantee the public release's equivalence, or prove data quality. (Paper §4.4, Figs. 4–6.)

Against the authors' own SFT-7B starting point, Table 1 reports the final model moving from 62.0 to 72.6 on AIME24, 48.4 to 64.8 on AIME25, 48.8 to 57.2 on LiveCodeBench v5, and 43.8 to 52.1 on v6, using the paper's avg@n protocol and default 32K inference limit. These +10.6, +16.4, +8.4, and +8.3 point changes establish performance under the reported pipeline; they do not identify which data row, verifier decision, or optimizer choice caused the gain.

The ablations supply more discriminating evidence. At Math Stage-2, training temperature 0.85 yields 67.6/56.8/52.1/47.1 on AIME24/AIME25/LCB v5/LCB v6, compared with 64.6/52.4/50.1/45.6 at 0.6 and 65.3/56.7/51.6/45.7 at 1.0; the authors turn this into an entropy-near-0.3 rule of thumb, not a universal optimum. Skipping 8K Stage-1 leads Stage-2 AIME25 to plateau at 51.8 rather than 56.7, although Stage-1 first lowers AIME25 from 48.4 to 44.6; the claimed reasoning-compression explanation is an author hypothesis. At final 32K math Stage-4, no overlong filtering outperforms filtering at a 32K evaluation cap: 71.4 vs 70.2 on AIME24, 63.5 vs 62.3 on AIME25, 53.5 vs 52.0 on LCB v5, and 48.0 vs 45.1 on v6. (Paper §§4.5.2–4.5.5, Figs. 8–10, Tables 2–3.)

The paper also reports that the AIME25 RL gain shrinks from 8.3 points at pass@8 to 1.2 at pass@128, while LiveCodeBench v6 retains a 5-point gain at pass@128. Appendix C uses 256 generated outputs per AIME item and 128 per LiveCodeBench item, resampling each k 100 times. This budget-sensitive result is evidence about sampling behavior, not about release completeness or verifier correctness. No independent reproduction is reported in the checked sources.

发布证据具体，但比训练主张更窄。官方 AceReason-1.1-SFT 页面报告 3,970,332 行数据：2,668,741 个数学样本与 1,301,591 个代码样本。viewer 只公开一个训练 split，包含四个字符串字段（category、source、input、output）；数据卡称所有 output 由 DeepSeek-R1 生成，许可证为 CC BY 4.0。AceReason-Math 另行公开 49,585 行 problem/answer，同样只有一个训练 split，并采用 CC BY 4.0。两项 artifact 都不含 rollout 组、reward log、阶段归属或代码 RL 测试。

SFT 扩展实验中，v1 包含 1.8 万个数学和 1.8 万个代码样本，v7 包含 120 万个数学和 100 万个代码样本。从 v3 到 v4，扩展唯一 prompt 并增加 1.6 万个数学样本，与 AIME24 提高 4 个百分点、AIME25 提高 2 个百分点相关。在 prompt 集合相近但每个 prompt 有更多 response 的条件下，v7 将 AIME25 从 v6 的 41.3 提高到 49.3。模型约在第 5–6 个 epoch 前持续改善。这些是作者设置下的七组混合实验；它们没有隔离教师质量，不能保证等同于公开发布物，也不能证明数据质量。（论文 §4.4，图 4–6。）

相对作者自己的 SFT-7B 起点，表 1 报告最终模型在 AIME24 上从 62.0 到 72.6，AIME25 从 48.4 到 64.8，LiveCodeBench v5 从 48.8 到 57.2，v6 从 43.8 到 52.1，采用论文的 avg@n 协议与默认 32K 推理上限。+10.6、+16.4、+8.4 和 +8.3 个百分点的变化证明了所报告管线下的性能，却不能识别是哪一行数据、哪次 verifier 决策或哪项 optimizer 选择导致增益。

消融提供了更有区分力的证据。在 Math Stage-2，训练 temperature 0.85 在 AIME24/AIME25/LCB v5/LCB v6 上得到 67.6/56.8/52.1/47.1；temperature 0.6 为 64.6/52.4/50.1/45.6，temperature 1.0 为 65.3/56.7/51.6/45.7。作者据此提出 entropy 约为 0.3 的经验规则，而非普遍最优值。跳过 8K Stage-1 后，Stage-2 的 AIME25 停在 51.8，而保留 Stage-1 时为 56.7，尽管 Stage-1 先把 AIME25 从 48.4 降至 44.6；所谓 reasoning compression 是作者假说。在最终 32K 数学 Stage-4，32K 评测上不使用 overlong filtering 优于使用过滤：AIME24 为 71.4 对 70.2，AIME25 为 63.5 对 62.3，LCB v5 为 53.5 对 52.0，v6 为 48.0 对 45.1。（论文 §4.5.2–4.5.5，图 8–10，表 2–3。）

论文还报告：AIME25 的 RL 增益从 pass@8 的 8.3 个百分点缩小到 pass@128 的 1.2，而 LiveCodeBench v6 在 pass@128 仍保留 5 个百分点增益。附录 C 为每个 AIME 条目生成 256 个 output，为每个 LiveCodeBench 条目生成 128 个 output，并对每个 k 重采样 100 次。这个预算敏感结果是采样行为证据，不是发布完整性或 verifier 正确性的证据。已核查来源未报告独立复现。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper's contribution is primarily a system-level study of how supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) interact for a single 7B math-and-code reasoner, rather than a new primitive training algorithm. It exposes several useful axes that are often collapsed in frontier-model reports: SFT mixture size and composition, staged context-length curricula, rollout temperature, the decision to skip or retain an easier RL stage, and stage-dependent handling of truncated responses.

Relative to AceReason-Nemotron 1.0, the reported recipe starts from a stronger joint math-and-code SFT checkpoint and studies a larger sequence of SFT mixtures. It then applies strict on-policy GRPO in separate math and code curricula. The temperature analysis uses a heuristic target of roughly 0.3 temperature-adjusted rollout entropy, and the overlong-response experiments show that a filter helpful at shorter contexts need not remain helpful at 32K. These are empirical design signals, not universal prescriptions.

The public SFT release adds practical value beyond the paper: it exposes 3,970,332 prompt-response rows with category, source, input, and output fields and states that every response was generated by DeepSeek-R1. The associated AceReason-Math release exposes 49,585 filtered math problems for RL-related use. However, neither release establishes an immutable row-level mapping to every paper training stage.

Several ingredients are not new: distillation from a stronger reasoning model, GRPO, curriculum learning, rule-based answer checking, code tests, and overlong-response filtering all predate this work. The distinctive contribution is the combined ablation record and the evidence that interventions may reverse effect as the context-length regime changes. Because the exact training code, code-verifier assets, and stage manifests are not released, the novelty should be read as a partially disclosed recipe and empirical study, not as a fully reproducible data pipeline.

本文的主要贡献是系统研究监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）如何协同训练一个 7B 数学与代码推理模型，而不是提出新的基础训练算法。它把前沿模型报告中经常被合并处理的若干轴线分别展开：SFT 混合数据的规模与组成、分阶段上下文长度课程、采样温度、是否跳过较容易的 RL 阶段，以及不同阶段对截断回答的处理方式。

与 AceReason-Nemotron 1.0 相比，报告中的方案从更强的数学—代码联合 SFT 检查点出发，并研究了更大范围的 SFT 数据混合；随后在数学和代码课程中分别采用严格同策略 GRPO。温度分析以约 0.3 的“温度调整后 rollout 熵”为启发式目标；超长回答实验则表明，在较短上下文中有益的过滤策略，到 32K 上下文时未必仍有益。这些结果是经验性设计信号，不是普适处方。

公开 SFT 数据集带来了论文之外的实际价值：它发布了 3,970,332 条提示—回答记录，字段为 category、source、input 和 output，并说明所有回答均由 DeepSeek-R1 生成。配套的 AceReason-Math 发布包含 49,585 道经过过滤、可用于 RL 相关工作的数学题。然而，这两项发布都没有给出与论文每个训练阶段之间不可变的逐行映射。

其中多项成分并非首次提出：从更强推理模型蒸馏、GRPO、课程学习、基于规则的答案检查、代码测试以及超长回答过滤都早于本工作。其较有辨识度的贡献是把这些因素放在同一套消融记录中，并给出干预效果可能随上下文长度制度改变而反转的证据。由于精确训练代码、代码验证器资产和阶段清单均未发布，这项贡献应被视为部分披露的训练配方与经验研究，而不是完全可复现的数据流水线。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The largest audit gap is the mismatch between the paper's training-accounting units and the public release. The paper describes a 383K-prompt filtered pool and a final v7 SFT blend of 2.2M samples (1.2M math and 1.0M code), while the public SFT dataset contains 3,970,332 rows derived from 514,807 source questions. No versioned manifest maps released rows, duplicates, or sampling weights to v1–v7 or to the checkpoint actually used to initialize RL.

The released SFT rows contain only category, source, input, and output. They do not expose a correctness judgment, rejection reason, verifier trace, generation seed, blend identifier, or train/validation/test partition beyond a single train split. The paper says responses were filtered and simpler or shorter examples were downsampled, but it does not provide sufficient row-level provenance to reconstruct those decisions. Treating long teacher responses as a proxy for difficult questions is the authors' operational heuristic, not direct evidence of difficulty.

The RL recipe is also incomplete. The paper reports 8 or 16 rollouts per prompt, a global batch of 128 prompts, token-level strict on-policy GRPO without KL regularization, and rule-based rewards. It does not disclose the allocation of 8 versus 16 rollouts across all stages, complete optimizer and seed settings, hardware, exact math-answer parsing rules, code execution sandbox, compiler/runtime versions, hidden tests, failure logs, or immutable prompt manifests. The public AceReason-Math dataset is related to math RL, but no equivalent code-RL prompt-and-test artifact is identified.

Rule-based verification introduces known label errors. The paper explicitly notes that defective code tests can create false negatives and weak tests can create false positives. Final-answer matching also checks outcome rather than the validity of the reasoning process. Group-normalized rewards, token-level loss, difficulty filtering, and truncation handling can induce selection or length effects that are not fully measured.

The seven SFT blends and staged RL comparisons are informative but not fully controlled causal experiments: mixture size, composition, response length, checkpoint history, and curriculum stage can change together. Benchmark improvements therefore do not by themselves validate data correctness or general quality. The paper reports overlap filtering against named evaluations, but it does not supply the matching code, thresholds for every source, or an independently reproducible contamination report. Upstream licenses and usage constraints still need to be checked source by source, and the reported results have not been independently reproduced within this Card.

最大的审计缺口，是论文中的训练统计单位与公开发布之间并不一致。论文描述了一个经筛选的 383K 题目池，以及包含 2.2M 样本（1.2M 数学、1.0M 代码）的最终 v7 SFT 混合；公开 SFT 数据集则包含 3,970,332 条记录，来源题目数为 514,807。当前没有版本化清单把发布记录、重复采样或采样权重映射到 v1–v7，或映射到实际用于初始化 RL 的检查点。

公开 SFT 记录只有 category、source、input 和 output 四个字段。数据没有提供正确性判断、拒绝原因、验证器轨迹、生成随机种子、混合版本标识，也没有除单一 train split 之外的训练/验证/测试划分。论文说明回答经过筛选，并对较简单或较短样本做了下采样，但没有提供足够的逐行来源信息来重建这些决策。把较长教师回答当作高难问题的代理，是作者采用的操作性启发式，而不是难度的直接证据。

RL 配方同样不完整。论文披露每个提示生成 8 或 16 条 rollout、全局批次为 128 个提示、采用无 KL 正则的 token 级严格同策略 GRPO，并使用规则奖励；但没有说明全部阶段中 8 与 16 的具体分配，也没有给出完整优化器和随机种子设置、硬件、精确数学答案解析规则、代码执行沙箱、编译器/运行时版本、隐藏测试、失败日志或不可变提示清单。公开 AceReason-Math 数据集与数学 RL 有关，但尚未识别出对应的代码 RL 提示—测试资产。

规则验证会引入已知标签错误。论文明确指出，错误的代码测试会造成假阴性，过弱的测试会造成假阳性。只匹配最终答案也只检查结果，不能确认推理过程是否有效。组归一化奖励、token 级损失、难度筛选和截断处理都可能带来尚未被充分测量的选择偏差或长度效应。

七种 SFT 混合与分阶段 RL 对比具有参考价值，但不是完全受控的因果实验：混合规模、组成、回答长度、检查点历史和课程阶段可能同时变化。因此，基准分数提升本身不能验证数据正确性或整体质量。论文报告对具名评测集进行了重叠过滤，但没有发布匹配代码、针对每个来源的完整阈值，或可独立复现的污染报告。上游数据的许可与使用约束仍需逐源核验；本卡也未对报告结果进行独立复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned Track 12, Frontier Reports as a Data Disclosure Ledger, this paper is useful because it exposes enough of the SFT and RL data lifecycle to support a structured audit while also making the disclosure boundary visible. The Card can record the data objects, source families, filtering rules, sampling axes, verifier contracts, curriculum transitions, and selected ablations without pretending that the complete production pipeline is public.

The report supports four practical uses. First, it is a comparison case for how SFT scale and composition interact with downstream RL. Second, its temperature, curriculum, and overlong-filtering ablations can inform hypotheses for controlled experiments. Third, the stated math-answer and code-test rewards provide a checklist for verifier audits, especially false-positive and false-negative analysis. Fourth, the discrepancy between the paper's 2.2M v7 blend and the 3,970,332-row public SFT release is a concrete example of why a disclosure ledger should distinguish the described training object from the downloadable artifact.

Reuse should be conditional on the artifact. The paper and this Card are suitable as audit and design references. The public AceReason-1.1-SFT and AceReason-Math datasets may be considered for training or evaluation only after pinning a revision, checking upstream-source rights, validating rows, and defining a local split and contamination policy. The released model can support behavioral comparison under its own license. None of these artifacts is sufficient to reproduce the full RL recipe because the code verifier, code tests, stage manifests, and exact stage-to-release mapping remain unavailable.

The strongest next audit action is to obtain immutable manifests for the final SFT initialization data and each RL stage, together with executable verifier definitions and rejected-rollout metadata. Until then, benchmark gains should be used as evidence about the reported model behavior, not as proof that the released data are correct, uncontaminated, or broadly reusable.

对于指定的 Track 12“Frontier Reports as a Data Disclosure Ledger”，本文的价值在于：它披露了足够多的 SFT 与 RL 数据生命周期信息，可支持结构化审计，同时也清楚暴露了披露边界。本卡可以记录数据对象、来源族、过滤规则、采样轴、验证器契约、课程阶段转换和部分消融，而不把尚未公开的生产流水线误写成完整开放。

这份报告支持四类实际用途。第一，它可作为研究 SFT 规模和组成如何与后续 RL 相互作用的比较案例。第二，温度、课程和超长回答过滤消融可用于提出受控实验假设。第三，论文给出的数学答案奖励与代码测试奖励可形成验证器审计清单，尤其适合检查假阳性和假阴性。第四，论文中的 2.2M v7 混合与公开 SFT 数据集的 3,970,332 条记录之间存在差异，这正说明披露账本必须区分“论文描述的训练对象”和“可下载的公开资产”。

复用方式应按资产分别判断。论文和本卡适合作为审计与方案设计参考。公开的 AceReason-1.1-SFT 与 AceReason-Math 数据集只有在固定 revision、核验上游来源权利、验证记录，并自行定义数据划分与污染策略后，才适合考虑用于训练或评估。公开模型可在其自身许可下用于行为比较。这些资产仍不足以复现完整 RL 配方，因为代码验证器、代码测试、阶段清单以及阶段与公开数据之间的精确映射均不可用。

最重要的下一项审计工作，是取得最终 SFT 初始化数据和每个 RL 阶段的不可变清单，并获得可执行的验证器定义与被拒 rollout 元数据。在此之前，基准提升只能作为报告模型行为的证据，不能作为公开数据正确、无污染或可广泛复用的证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.1–3.2 together with Figures 2–3. The RL configuration uses 8 or 16 rollouts per prompt; it should not be summarized as a fixed 16-rollout recipe.
  • Compare the paper's 383K filtered prompt pool and 2.2M-sample v7 blend with the public SFT release: 3,970,332 rows from 514,807 source questions and only four content fields. The paper does not publish a row-level mapping between them.
  • Use Figure 8 and Tables 2–3 to separate three claims: the temperature comparison, the value of retaining Math Stage I before Stage II, and the reversal of overlong-filtering benefit at 32K context.
  • Treat the released model weights and AceReason-Math as partial official artifacts. They do not supply the code-RL prompts, tests, execution environment, rejected rollouts, or a complete training implementation.
  • The highest-value follow-up is an immutable manifest for the final SFT blend and all RL stages, plus executable math and code verifier definitions and provenance for rejected samples.

• 应把第 3.1–3.2 节与图 2–3 一起阅读。RL 配置为每个提示生成 8 或 16 条 rollout，不能概括成固定 16 条的配方。
  • 应对照论文中的 383K 经筛选题目池、2.2M 样本 v7 混合与公开 SFT 发布：后者有 3,970,332 条记录，来自 514,807 道源题目，且只有四个内容字段。论文没有发布二者之间的逐行映射。
  • 阅读图 8 和表 2–3 时，应区分三个结论：采样温度比较、在 Math Stage II 之前保留 Stage I 的价值，以及超长回答过滤在 32K 上下文时出现的效果反转。
  • 公开模型权重与 AceReason-Math 只能视为部分官方资产；它们没有提供代码 RL 提示、测试、执行环境、被拒 rollout 或完整训练实现。
  • 最有价值的后续材料，是最终 SFT 混合与全部 RL 阶段的不可变清单，以及可执行的数学/代码验证器定义和被拒样本来源信息。

value.html: The paper reports 247K math prompts from AceMath, NuminaMath, and OpenMathReasoning plus 136K code prompts from TACO, APPS, OpenCoder-Stage2, and OpenCodeReasoning after filtering. The official AceReason-1.1-SFT release instead enumerates OpenMathReasoning, NuminaMath-CoT, OpenCodeReasoning, MagicoderEvolInstruct, opc-sft-stage2, leetcode, TACO, and apps. Its source counts sum to 514,807 questions and 3,970,332 samples, so it is not an immutable copy of the paper's 383K-prompt, 2.2M-sample v7 blend. RL reuses math and code data from AceReason-Nemotron-1.0; AceReason-Math is a related official release, but no stage-to-record mapping or complete code-RL release is established.

value_zh.html: 论文报告过滤后有来自 AceMath、NuminaMath 与 OpenMathReasoning 的 247K 数学提示，以及来自 TACO、APPS、OpenCoder-Stage2 与 OpenCodeReasoning 的 136K 代码提示。官方 AceReason-1.1-SFT 发布则列举 OpenMathReasoning、NuminaMath-CoT、OpenCodeReasoning、MagicoderEvolInstruct、opc-sft-stage2、leetcode、TACO 与 apps。其来源计数合计 514,807 个问题与 3,970,332 个样本，因此它不是论文 383K 提示、2.2M 样本 v7 混合的不可变副本。RL 复用 AceReason-Nemotron-1.0 的数学与代码数据；AceReason-Math 是相关官方发布，但未确立阶段到记录的映射或完整的 code-RL 发布。

value.html: The released SFT train split has four string columns: category, source, input, and output. The output stores the teacher response, including the reasoning text and final response, but has no separate verifier result, reward, or acceptance field. The paper's evaluation format asks for boxed math answers and fenced Python code; unreleased RL records are described as question, ground-truth answer, a group of 8 or 16 responses, and rule-derived group rewards.

value_zh.html: 已发布的 SFT train 划分有四个字符串列：category、source、input 与 output。output 存储教师模型回复，包括推理文本与最终回复，但没有单独的验证器结果、奖励或接受字段。论文的评测格式要求 boxed 数学答案与围栏 Python 代码；未发布的 RL 记录被描述为 question、ground-truth answer、一组 8 或 16 条回复，以及规则导出的组奖励。

value.html: Every output in the official AceReason-1.1-SFT release is stated to be generated by DeepSeek-R1; the paper later describes the teacher-forced SFT responses as DeepSeek-R1-671B outputs. RL rollouts are sampled on policy from the current checkpoint. Per-record upstream authorship and the accepted/rejected RL rollout groups are not released.

value_zh.html: 官方 AceReason-1.1-SFT 发布中的每条输出据称由 DeepSeek-R1 生成；论文随后将教师强制 SFT 回复描述为 DeepSeek-R1-671B 输出。RL rollout 由当前检查点按策略采样。逐条记录的上游作者归属以及接受/拒绝的 RL rollout 组未发布。

items: released SFT columns: category, source, input, output

value.html: Offline mathematics and code tasks. Math outputs are checked against ground-truth answers; code outputs are compiled and run against predefined tests. The answer normalizer, compiler/interpreter versions, test suites, sandbox, timeouts, and replay image are not released in the checked artifacts.

value_zh.html: 离线数学与代码任务。数学输出对照标准答案检查；代码输出经编译并在预定义测试上运行。答案规范化器、编译器/解释器版本、测试套件、沙箱、超时与回放镜像在所检查产物中未发布。

value.html: RL uses rule-based verification against ground-truth answers. Group scores are standardized into token-level GRPO advantages; the paper uses a token-level policy-gradient objective and removes the KL term. Exact math extraction/equivalence rules, code tests, reward code, calibration, and measured verifier error rates are unknown.

value_zh.html: RL 使用基于规则、对照标准答案的核验。组分数被标准化为 token 级 GRPO 优势；论文使用 token 级策略梯度目标并去掉 KL 项。精确的数学提取/等价规则、代码测试、奖励代码、校准与测得的验证器错误率未知。

value.html: Math: the parsed final answer matches the ground-truth answer under an undisclosed rule. Code: the generated program compiles and passes the predefined test cases. Truncated responses may be masked or negatively rewarded depending on the overlong-filtering setting; exact predicates are unavailable.

value_zh.html: 数学：解析后的最终答案在未披露规则下与标准答案匹配。代码：生成的程序编译通过并通过预定义测试用例。截断回复可能根据 overlong-filtering 设置被掩码或负奖励；精确谓词不可得。

value.html: Qwen2.5-Math-7B; rope_theta is changed from 10,000 to 1,000,000 to support a reported 128K context.

value_zh.html: Qwen2.5-Math-7B；rope_theta 从 10,000 改为 1,000,000 以支持所报告的 128K 上下文。

value.html: DeepSeek-R1 generates the SFT responses; Section 4.5.4 identifies the teacher-forced responses as DeepSeek-R1-671B outputs. No separate teacher is reported for on-policy RL.

value_zh.html: DeepSeek-R1 生成 SFT 回复；第 4.5.4 节将教师强制回复标识为 DeepSeek-R1-671B 输出。未报告 on-policy RL 的单独教师模型。

value.html: DeepSeek-R1 generates SFT outputs for collected prompts. During RL, the current policy samples 8 or 16 rollouts per question under strict on-policy training.

value_zh.html: DeepSeek-R1 为收集的提示生成 SFT 输出。RL 期间，当前策略在严格 on-policy 训练下每题采样 8 或 16 条 rollout。

value.html: The paper reports G=8 or 16 rollouts per question, a global batch of 128 prompts, and one policy-gradient update after each batch. Its curriculum is math-only RL at 8K, 16K, and 24K response budgets; code-only RL at 24K and 32K; then math-only RL at 32K. The public SFT release has 3,970,332 samples, whereas the experimental v7 blend has 2.2M; the exact consumed subset and revisions are not pinned.

value_zh.html: 论文报告每题 G=8 或 16 条 rollout、全局 batch 128 条提示，以及每 batch 后一次策略梯度更新。其课程为 8K、16K 与 24K 回复预算下的仅数学 RL；24K 与 32K 的仅代码 RL；然后 32K 的仅数学 RL。公开 SFT 发布有 3,970,332 个样本，而实验 v7 混合有 2.2M；确切消耗的子集与修订未钉扎。

value.html: The paper studies RL temperatures 0.6, 0.85, and 1.0 and gives a rule of thumb of keeping temperature-adjusted entropy around 0.3; a single complete per-stage training-temperature schedule is not disclosed. Evaluation defaults to temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.95.

value_zh.html: 论文研究 RL 温度 0.6、0.85 与 1.0，并给出将温度调整后熵保持在约 0.3 的经验规则；完整的单套分阶段训练温度日程未披露。评测默认温度为 0.6、top-p 为 0.95。

value.html: SFT prompts are deduplicated; samples with 9-gram overlap to math or code benchmark test samples are removed; simple prompts, proxied by short teacher-response length, are randomly downsampled. Later RL stages shift toward harder prompts. Code Stage-II removes problems for which every rollout from the previous epoch checkpoint passes every test; final math Stage-4 similarly removes questions solved by every rollout.

value_zh.html: SFT 提示经去重；与数学或代码基准测试样本有 9-gram 重叠的样本被移除；以教师模型回复长度较短作为简单提示的代理，进行随机下采样。后续 RL 阶段转向更难的提示。Code Stage-II 移除上一 epoch 检查点的每条 rollout 都通过全部测试的问题；最终数学 Stage-4 同样移除每条 rollout 都解出的问题。

value.html: RL response-length budgets grow from 8K to 32K. Official evaluation uses a 32,768-token maximum by default, with benchmark-specific avg@n sampling; some overlong-filtering ablations also evaluate at 64K.

value_zh.html: RL 回复长度预算从 8K 增至 32K。官方评测默认使用 32,768-token 上限，并按基准使用 avg@n 采样；部分 overlong-filtering 消融也在 64K 评测。

value.html: Strictly on-policy GRPO in veRL, with a token-level policy-gradient loss, G=8 or 16 responses per question, 128 prompts per global batch, one update per batch, and no KL term. Optimizer, learning rate, clipping, hardware, seeds, exact stage temperatures, and full checkpoint schedule are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 在 veRL 中严格 on-policy 的 GRPO，采用 token 级策略梯度损失、每题 G=8 或 16 条回复、每全局 batch 128 条提示、每 batch 一次更新，且无 KL 项。优化器、学习率、clipping、硬件、种子、精确阶段温度与完整检查点日程未披露。

value.html: The official SFT release exposes category/source/input/output and source-level question/sample counts, and says all outputs are DeepSeek-R1 generations. The paper's v1-v7 study uses a different 383K-prompt pool and a 2.2M-sample v7 blend. No immutable manifest maps release rows to experimental blends, filtering decisions, or the final checkpoint. The RL mixture is inherited from AceReason-Nemotron-1.0 and only partially represented by the related AceReason-Math release.

value_zh.html: 官方 SFT 发布暴露 category/source/input/output 与来源级问题/样本计数，并称全部输出为 DeepSeek-R1 生成。论文的 v1-v7 研究使用不同的 383K 提示池与 2.2M 样本的 v7 混合。没有不可变清单将发布行映射到实验混合、过滤决策或最终检查点。RL 混合物继承自 AceReason-Nemotron-1.0，且仅由相关 AceReason-Math 发布部分代表。

value.html: Both checked NVIDIA datasets expose only a train split. The paper reports prompt deduplication and benchmark-overlap filtering but not a complete immutable train/validation/test manifest for the SFT blend or stage-specific math/code RL curricula.

value_zh.html: 两个经检查的 NVIDIA 数据集仅暴露 train 划分。论文报告了提示去重与基准重叠过滤，但未给出 SFT 混合或阶段特定数学/代码 RL 课程的完整不可变 train/validation/test 清单。

value.html: The paper and SFT dataset card state that any sample with 9-gram overlap to a math or coding benchmark test sample is removed. The benchmark inventory, normalization, matching implementation, removal counts, generated-output checks, and residual-overlap audit are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 论文与 SFT 数据集卡片声明，任何与数学或编程基准测试样本有 9-gram 重叠的样本均被移除。基准清单、规范化、匹配实现、移除计数、生成输出检查与残余重叠审计未披露。

items: The official SFT release contains 3,970,332 samples and 514,807 source-counted questions, while the paper's final experimental blend contains 2.2M samples drawn from 383K prompts; treating them as identical would misstate training lineage.
The paper explicitly notes that incorrect code tests cause false-negative rewards and overly simple tests cause false positives; the tests and their error analysis are not released.

Long teacher outputs are used as a proxy for problem difficulty during SFT filtering, which can confound difficulty with teacher verbosity or style; the paper does not validate this proxy against independent difficulty labels.

Only successful/unsuccessful group rewards are described; rejected rollouts, truncated responses, reward logs, and stage-specific prompt manifests are unavailable, limiting reward-hacking and selection-bias audits.
The 9-gram decontamination procedure lacks a released benchmark list, normalization code, yields, and residual-leakage measurement.
官方 SFT 发布含 3,970,332 个样本与 514,807 个来源计数问题，而论文最终实验混合含取自 383K 提示的 2.2M 样本；将其视为同一会误述训练谱系。
论文明确指出错误的代码测试会导致假阴性奖励，而过于简单的测试会导致假阳性；测试及其错误分析未发布。
SFT 过滤中用较长的教师模型输出作为问题难度代理，这可能将难度与教师模型冗长或风格混淆；论文未用独立难度标签核验该代理。
仅描述成功/不成功的组奖励；被拒绝的 rollout、截断回复、奖励日志与阶段特定提示清单不可得，限制了奖励劫持与选择偏差审计。
9-gram 去污染程序缺少已发布的基准列表、规范化代码、产量与残余泄漏测量。
